title: Score
description: Complete public Beatlab composition program. It may use plain tracks, patterns plus arrangement, or both.

bpm.description: Constant tempo when tempoMap is absent. When tempoMap is present, this may be omitted; if supplied, it must match tempoMap[0].bpm.

tempoMap.description: Ordered tempo segments; first point starts at beat 0.

seed.description: Unsigned 32-bit deterministic seed for authored and renderer variation.

patterns.description: Pattern definitions. Each object key declares the Pattern's name and must use 1..48 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

triggers.description: Named silent control patterns used by pump and custom-bus sidechains.

motifs.description: Named reusable pitched phrases. Every declared entry is validated even when no Pattern references it.

x-beatlab-constraints: A Score requires a non-empty tracks array, or both a non-empty patterns object and a non-empty arrangement array. Both forms may coexist.
patterns and arrangement are a pair: supplying either one requires the other, even when tracks is also present.
tempoMap begins at beat 0, is strictly increasing, and its first bpm matches top-level bpm when bpm is supplied.
All names and references resolve; pattern inheritance, motif inheritance, and the routing graph are acyclic.
Every Track.id is unique among top-level tracks.
Unknown Score properties, wrong JSON types, and supplied numeric values outside their documented ranges are compiler errors; values are never coerced or clamped.
JSON Schema default values are documentation annotations; the Beatlab compiler, not a generic validator, applies defaults.

Curve.title: Curve
Curve.description: String enum controlling interpolation from one point to the next.

Depth.title: Depth
Depth.description: String enum for front-to-back lane placement. Omission leaves the lane at neutral mid depth.

x-beatlab-values.front: closer: slightly louder with added presence
x-beatlab-values.back: farther away: quieter, darker, and sent more strongly to the room

Tone.title: Tone
Tone.description: String enum for lane spectral character. Omission leaves the lane spectrally neutral.

x-beatlab-values.warm: adds low-mid body and gently reduces high frequencies
x-beatlab-values.bright: adds high-frequency presence and reduces low-mid masking

RepeatParity.title: RepeatParity
RepeatParity.description: String enum selecting odd- or even-numbered one-based Placement repetitions.

AutomationCurve.title: AutomationCurve
AutomationCurve.description: String enum controlling interpolation into an automation keyframe.

ScaleName.title: ScaleName
ScaleName.description: String enum selecting one built-in musical scale, generated from the compiler's scale table.

MeterDenominator.title: MeterDenominator
MeterDenominator.description: Numeric enum selecting the beat unit used as a time-signature denominator.

SweepKnob.title: SweepKnob
SweepKnob.description: String enum selecting one compact 0..10 Sweep target.
x-beatlab-constraints: fader and pan are intentionally absent; use TrackParam track.fader or track.pan.

FilterSweepKnob.title: FilterSweepKnob
FilterSweepKnob.description: String enum selecting a compact track filter whose resonance can be changed by Sweep.res.

LfoSweepKnob.title: LfoSweepKnob
LfoSweepKnob.description: String enum selecting a compact Sweep target that supports continuous LFO movement.

BusSweepParam.title: BusSweepParam
BusSweepParam.description: String enum selecting the numeric custom-Bus, effect, or send property moved by a BusSweep. The selected bus object determines which enum values are legal.

x-beatlab-values.sidechain.amount: Bus property only; 0..10; the selected Bus must declare sidechain

MasterMoveEffect.title: MasterMoveEffect
MasterMoveEffect.description: String enum selecting one bounded master-bus performance effect.

BusRole.title: BusRole
BusRole.description: String enum selecting the mixer behavior inherited by a custom Bus.

BusFilterMode.title: BusFilterMode
BusFilterMode.description: String enum selecting a custom-Bus filter direction.

BuiltInReturn.title: BuiltInReturn
BuiltInReturn.description: String enum selecting one built-in shared effect return.

SendTarget.title: SendTarget
SendTarget.description: A built-in shared return or the exact key of one declared custom Bus.
SendTarget.x-beatlab-syntax: BuiltInReturn | one of the keys in Score.buses Dictionary<string, Bus>
x-beatlab-constraints: A custom Bus key must resolve in the same Score.

SendTap.title: SendTap
SendTap.description: String enum selecting where a Send copies its source Bus audio.

x-beatlab-values.pre: copy the Bus input before its effects, sidechain ducking, fader, and pan
x-beatlab-values.post: copy the completed Bus output after its effects, sidechain ducking, fader, and pan

CompactOscillatorType.title: CompactOscillatorType
CompactOscillatorType.description: String enum selecting the oscillator architecture of a CompactSynthPatch.

SynthNoiseColor.title: SynthNoiseColor
SynthNoiseColor.description: String enum selecting the spectral character of synthesized noise.

CompactLfoShape.title: CompactLfoShape
CompactLfoShape.description: String enum selecting the LFO waveform available to a CompactSynthPatch.

OscillatorPhase.title: OscillatorPhase
OscillatorPhase.description: String enum selecting how a dual-patch oscillator chooses its phase at note onset.

SynthLfoShape.title: SynthLfoShape
SynthLfoShape.description: String enum selecting the waveform of a dual-patch SynthLfo.

ModulationSource.title: ModulationSource
ModulationSource.description: String enum selecting the signal that drives a dual-patch modulation route.

ModulationTarget.title: ModulationTarget
ModulationTarget.description: String enum selecting the parameter moved by a dual-patch modulation route.

SynthFilterMode.title: SynthFilterMode
SynthFilterMode.description: String enum selecting the filter response of a DualSynthPatch.

DrumChokeMode.title: DrumChokeMode
DrumChokeMode.description: String enum selecting the hi-hat choke role of a synthesized noise drum.

x-beatlab-values.none: ordinary noise percussion; does not join the physical hi-hat choke group
x-beatlab-values.closed: closed-hi-hat role; cuts ringing open-role hits when the final route is the kit bus
x-beatlab-values.open: open-hi-hat role; may be cut by later closed-role hits when the final route is the kit bus

DrumModel.title: DrumModel
DrumModel.description: String enum selecting the custom drum synthesis algorithm and its allowed model-specific fields.

x-beatlab-values.kick: pitched body sweeping from pitchStartHz toward tuneHz
x-beatlab-values.membrane: drum-head body with damping and attack noise
x-beatlab-values.clap: several short noise bursts with seeded timing/level looseness and an optional tonal body
x-beatlab-values.noise: noise percussion such as a hi-hat or shaker
x-beatlab-values.metal: inharmonic metallic partials with optional click and noise

DrumBus.title: DrumBus
DrumBus.description: String enum selecting the generated drum's mixer role.

x-beatlab-values.kit: main drum-kit bus, including kick-keyed glue processing
x-beatlab-values.perc: percussion bus, outside the main kit glue processing

DrumNoiseColor.title: DrumNoiseColor
DrumNoiseColor.description: String enum selecting the spectral balance of a custom drum's noise component.

PitchedInstrumentName.title: PitchedInstrumentName
PitchedInstrumentName.description: Closed factory pitched-instrument symbol table, generated from the engine registry.
PitchedInstrumentName.x-beatlab-syntax: one exact name from the generated factory catalog

FactoryDrumHitName.title: FactoryDrumHitName
FactoryDrumHitName.description: Closed factory drum symbol table, generated from the engine registry.
FactoryDrumHitName.x-beatlab-syntax: string enum (one exact value listed below)

InstrumentName.title: InstrumentName
InstrumentName.description: A factory instrument, drums lane, declared custom synth/drum, or declared resample.

oneOf.description: Exact key declared in top-level synths, drumSynths, or resamples.

x-beatlab-syntax: | one of the keys in Score.synths Dictionary<string, SynthPatch>
| one of the keys in Score.drumSynths Dictionary<string, CustomDrumPatch>
| one of the keys in Score.resamples Dictionary<string, Resample>
x-beatlab-constraints: Every non-factory name must resolve to a matching top-level declaration.

DrumHitName.title: DrumHitName
DrumHitName.description: A factory drum or declared exd_ custom drum used inside a drums lane.
DrumHitName.x-beatlab-syntax: FactoryDrumHitName | one of the keys in Score.drumSynths Dictionary<string, CustomDrumPatch>
x-beatlab-constraints: For a custom drum, write the drumSynths dictionary key, not the CustomDrumPatch object.
An exd_ value must exactly match a key declared in the same Score's drumSynths dictionary.

PumpSource.title: PumpSource
PumpSource.description: One exact public source for track pump. Select a top-level Track, an arranged Pattern, every lane using an instrument, one drum-hit name, or a silent Trigger; the selector is a string reference, not the referenced object.

oneOf.title: Track pump source
oneOf.description: Trigger from notes produced by exactly one top-level Track.

track.description: Exact id property of one object in top-level Score.tracks.

oneOf.title: Pattern pump source
oneOf.description: Trigger from every placement of exactly one Pattern.

pattern.description: Exact key in the top-level Score.patterns Dictionary<string, Pattern>.

oneOf.title: Instrument pump source
oneOf.description: Trigger from every Track or arranged Pattern globally using exactly one public instrument.

instrument.description: Exact instrument property used by a Track or Pattern in this Score.

oneOf.title: Drum-hit pump source
oneOf.description: Trigger from every occurrence of exactly one public drum hit, including hits inside drums lanes and single-drum lanes.

drumHit.description: Exact factory drum hit or key declared in Score.drumSynths.

oneOf.title: Silent trigger pump source
oneOf.description: Trigger from every compiled event in one silent Trigger timeline.

trigger.description: Exact key in the top-level Score.triggers Dictionary<string, Trigger>.

x-beatlab-constraints: Exactly one selector property is required in each PumpSource object.
Every referenced source must produce at least one rendered note or compiled Trigger event; unresolved or unused sources are compiler errors.
Several PumpSource values are combined into one time-sorted onset stream; duplicate sources are errors and array order has no effect.
Public instrument and drum-hit identities are preserved through compilation; internal renderer voice groups never participate in matching.

SidechainSource.title: SidechainSource
SidechainSource.description: One exact detector source for a custom Bus sidechain. Track, Pattern, and instrument selectors follow their completed post-fader audio; drumHit and trigger selectors create fixed control pulses; bus selects one declared custom Bus's post-fader output.

oneOf.title: Pattern sidechain source
oneOf.description: Follow every placement of exactly one Pattern.

oneOf.title: Instrument sidechain source
oneOf.description: Follow every lane globally using one public instrument.

oneOf.title: Drum-hit sidechain source
oneOf.description: Create a control pulse at every occurrence of one public drum hit.

oneOf.title: Silent Trigger sidechain source
oneOf.description: Create a control pulse at every event in one silent Trigger.

oneOf.title: Custom Bus sidechain source
oneOf.description: Follow one declared custom Bus's completed post-fader audio.

bus.description: Exact key in Score.buses; built-in role buses are not valid detector sources.

x-beatlab-constraints: Exactly one selector property is required in each SidechainSource object.
All sources must resolve and duplicates are errors.
Several sources are combined by their strongest detector level at each sample; array order has no effect and source audio cannot phase-cancel another source.

TriggerPlacement.title: TriggerPlacement
TriggerPlacement.description: Place and optionally repeat one silent Trigger pattern on the global beat timeline. Array order has no effect; every placement carries its own absolute atBeat.

Trigger.title: Trigger
Trigger.description: Silent repeating control pattern for rhythmic pumping and bus sidechain ducking. It schedules detector events and never renders an instrument.

lenBeats.description: Length of one trigger cycle in beats.

hits.description: Unique local trigger positions, each less than lenBeats.

placements.description: Global placements of this trigger pattern.

x-beatlab-constraints: Every hit is finite, unique, at least 0, and strictly less than lenBeats.
Trigger events outside score.durationSec are discarded; each declared Trigger must retain at least one event inside the score.
hits and placements array order has no effect. Coincident events created by different placements collapse into one detector event.
The complete Score may retain at most 100000 unique Trigger events after duration clipping and coincidence removal.
Triggers generate no audio and do not require an instrument.

AbsolutePitch.title: AbsolutePitch
AbsolutePitch.description: One exact pitch written as a note letter, optional accidental, and octave number.
x-beatlab-constraints: The letter is A through G. Uppercase is the canonical spelling; lowercase is accepted.
The optional # raises the note by one semitone; the optional lowercase b lowers it by one semitone.
The octave changes at C: C4 is middle C and A4 is 440 Hz.
Unusual spellings such as Cb4, B#3, E#4, and Fb4 are valid musical notes.
Pitch-token validity is separate from an instrument's playable or recorded range.

ScaleDegreePitch.title: ScaleDegreePitch
ScaleDegreePitch.description: A pitch resolved relative to Score.harmony.tonic and its scale or pitchSet.
x-beatlab-constraints: The leading ^ is required and the degree is an integer from 1 through 13.
Degrees follow the declared scale: in a seven-note scale, ^8 repeats ^1 one octave higher and ^9 repeats ^2 one octave higher.
The optional b or bb lowers the resolved degree by one or two semitones; # or ## raises it by one or two semitones.
Mixed accidentals b# and #b are not accepted.
The optional @octave fixes the register to -1 through 8. Without it, the enclosing note/placement register or harmony.octave applies.
A top-level Score.harmony object is required whenever a scale-degree pitch is used.

PitchToken.title: PitchToken
PitchToken.description: A pitched note: either one exact absolute pitch or a scale degree resolved through Score.harmony.
x-beatlab-constraints: PitchToken is used by pitched instruments. Drum lanes use DrumHitName instead.

ChordVoicing.title: ChordVoicing
ChordVoicing.description: Reusable name or explicit octave placement for every tone in a chord.

oneOf.description: Case-sensitive key from Score.harmony.voicings. The key must exist.
One octave offset per chord tone, in the same order as Chord.tones.

ChordVoicing.x-beatlab-syntax: one of the keys in Score.harmony.voicings Dictionary<string, integer[]> | integer[]

x-beatlab-values.integer[]: one -4..4 octave offset per chord tone, in Chord.tones order

x-beatlab-constraints: An explicit array must contain exactly one offset for every tone in the chord.
Each offset moves its corresponding tone by that many whole octaves; it does not add or remove tones.

StretchMode.title: StretchMode
StretchMode.description: Fixed sampled-playback mode that fits a take to the note duration without changing pitch.

BowDirection.title: BowDirection
BowDirection.description: Explicit recorded bow direction for a sampled bank that declares directional takes.

x-beatlab-values.natural: play the recording's declared natural note-off when available

ResampleRegion.title: ResampleRegion
ResampleRegion.description: Selects audio from the resample named by the enclosing Track or Pattern instrument: all plays the complete capture, a slices.regions key selects its declared beat range, and an integer selects a zero-based slice generated by gridBeats or transients.

oneOf.description: Exact key from the current resample's slices.regions dictionary.
Zero-based index generated by the current resample's gridBeats or transients slicing method.

x-beatlab-syntax: | one of the keys in Score.resamples.<current instrument>.slices.regions Dictionary<string, [number, number]>
x-beatlab-constraints: The current instrument is the rs_ instrument used by the Note's enclosing Track or Pattern.
A region key or generated-slice index is local to that resample and must resolve there.
An integer is valid only with gridBeats or transients; it is a slice index, not a beat position.

PitchRange.title: PitchRange
PitchRange.description: Ascending absolute-pitch range written as [lowest pitch, highest pitch]. Both endpoints are inclusive.
x-beatlab-constraints: The first pitch must not be above the second.

TrackBusName.title: TrackBusName
TrackBusName.description: Built-in musical role or declared custom-bus name.
TrackBusName.x-beatlab-syntax: BusRole | one of the keys in Score.buses Dictionary<string, Bus>

SynthControls.title: SynthControls
SynthControls.description: The 16 public 0..10 front-panel controls for pitched synth instruments. This is the only control map accepted by per-note c. An omitted control makes no override, so the enclosing layer or selected synth patch remains.

cutoff.description: Pitched-synth filter cutoff. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

resonance.description: Pitched-synth filter resonance; distinct from the track filter control res. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

envMod.description: Amount the pitched synth's filter envelope moves its cutoff per note. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

attack.description: Pitched-synth amplitude-envelope attack time. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

decay.description: Pitched-synth amplitude and filter-envelope decay time. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

sustain.description: Pitched-synth held amplitude after decay. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

release.description: Pitched-synth amplitude-envelope release time. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

drive.description: Pitched-synth voice saturation. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

detune.description: Pitched-synth unison spread. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

sub.description: Pitched-synth sub-oscillator level. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

noise.description: Pitched-synth noise level. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

lfoRate.description: Pitched-synth LFO rate. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

wobble.description: Pitched-synth LFO-to-filter depth. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

vibrato.description: Pitched-synth LFO-to-pitch depth. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

sweep.description: Pitched-synth cutoff movement across each note. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

pitchDrop.description: Pitched-synth attack pitch displacement that converges to the written pitch. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

TrackControls.title: TrackControls
TrackControls.description: Combined static lane controls: pitched-synth front panel plus lane effects. Every numeric control must be a JSON number in its documented range; omission preserves the stated default or selected synth patch value.

pump.description: Onset-triggered ducking depth; 0 is off and 10 ducks by up to 85%.

reverb.description: Send level to the shared hall; not affected by wet.

lowpass.description: Track low-pass filter: 0 is open/bypassed and 10 closes toward low frequencies.

highpass.description: Track high-pass filter: 0 is open/bypassed and 10 removes frequencies up to about 2.4 kHz.

res.description: Static resonance baseline shared by the track's lowpass and highpass. A sweep's res overrides only its named filter from that sweep's first beat onward.

tape.description: Tape-style saturation, softening, and wobble amount.

plate.description: Send level to the shared bright plate; not affected by wet.

vinyl.description: Record-player bandwidth, wobble, and deterministic crackle amount.

drive.description: Pitched-synth voice saturation on a pitched synth; track distortion on a recorded sound or drum.
drive.x-beatlab-effective-default: selected synth patch value on pitched synths; 0 on recorded sounds and drums

pumpRelease.description: Pump recovery duration control: 0 is 0.15 beats and 10 is 1.5 beats.

pumpHold.description: Fully ducked hold before recovery: 0 is none and 10 is 120 ms.

pumpShape.description: Pump recovery-curve shape: higher values recover later.

wet.description: Wet share of the color chain (EQ, wah, drive, crush, modulation, tremolo, echo, tape, dynamics, and vinyl). Filters, pump, hall, and plate are outside this blend.

pumpFrom.description: One or more exact public sources whose note onsets trigger pump. Array order has no effect.

cutoff.description: Pitched-synth filter cutoff. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

resonance.description: Pitched-synth filter resonance; distinct from the track filter control res. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

envMod.description: Amount the pitched synth's filter envelope moves its cutoff per note. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

attack.description: Pitched-synth amplitude-envelope attack time. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

decay.description: Pitched-synth amplitude and filter-envelope decay time. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

sustain.description: Pitched-synth held amplitude after decay. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

release.description: Pitched-synth amplitude-envelope release time. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

detune.description: Pitched-synth unison spread. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

sub.description: Pitched-synth sub-oscillator level. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

noise.description: Pitched-synth noise level. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

lfoRate.description: Pitched-synth LFO rate. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

wobble.description: Pitched-synth LFO-to-filter depth. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

vibrato.description: Pitched-synth LFO-to-pitch depth. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

sweep.description: Pitched-synth cutoff movement across each note. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

pitchDrop.description: Pitched-synth attack pitch displacement that converges to the written pitch. Omission preserves the selected patch value.

x-beatlab-constraints: Synth controls affect pitched synth instruments only; they do not control recorded instruments or synthesized/recorded drums. Track effects work on every instrument.
Unknown fields and invalid numeric control values are compiler errors; numeric controls require finite JSON numbers within their documented ranges.
pumpFrom is required when static pump is greater than 0 or a pump Sweep targets the lane. Its value is PumpSource[], never a string.
eqLow/eqMid/eqHigh use dB rather than 0..10.

NoteLine.title: NoteLine
NoteLine.description: Token-efficient positional note string. Time/duration are seconds on a plain Track and beats inside a Pattern or Motif.
x-beatlab-constraints: All fixed positional values are required. An optional pan number comes next, followed by zero to four tags.
Time must be 0 or greater; pitched duration must be greater than 0; volume is 0.01..1; pan is -1..1.

Tags are pN (N = 0..1), @ms (signed integer milliseconds), flam, and rollN (N = integer 1..16). Each tag kind may appear once; unknown and duplicate tags are errors. flam and rollN are mutually exclusive.
Use a Note object for harmony events, expressions, sample options, controls, or granular settings.

ExpressionPoint.title: ExpressionPoint
ExpressionPoint.description: One value at one normalized position within a note expression curve.

x-beatlab-values.phase: 0..1 — 0 is the beginning of the note and 1 is the end
x-beatlab-values.value: The containing Expression property determines the allowed range

x-beatlab-constraints: An ExpressionPoint always contains exactly two numbers.

ArpOrder.title: ArpOrder
ArpOrder.description: Fixed order in which an arpeggio emits its generated chord notes.
x-beatlab-constraints: random uses the Score seed and is deterministic for the same score.

Expression.title: Expression
Expression.description: Normalized performance curves evaluated across one note.

x-beatlab-values.gain: point value 0..2 — multiplier on the note's authored gain
x-beatlab-values.pitchCents: point value -2400..2400 — additive pitch displacement in cents
x-beatlab-values.pan: point value -1..1 — additive offset from the note's static pan
x-beatlab-values.vibrato: point value 0..1 — depth mapped to 0..40 cents at 5.2 Hz

x-beatlab-constraints: Every curve begins at phase 0, ends at phase 1, and has strictly increasing phases.
Each curve contains 2..32 ExpressionPoint values.

Arp.title: Arp
Arp.description: Deterministic arpeggiation of a named chord event. It may appear only on a Note that uses chord.

stepBeats.description: Distance between generated notes in beats.

gate.description: Generated duration as a fraction of stepBeats.

x-beatlab-constraints: Arp requires Note.chord and is forbidden with Note.note.

Note.title: Note
Note.description: Full note form shared by tracks, patterns, and motifs. The enclosing collection determines time units.

t.description: Local onset in seconds. Legal only inside a direct Track.

b.description: Pattern- or motif-local onset in beats.

note.description: Pitch, degree, or drum hit. Mutually exclusive with chord.

chord.description: One of the keys in Score.harmony.chords Dictionary<string, Chord>. Mutually exclusive with note.

octave.description: Register used for a degree or chord.

voicing.x-beatlab-effective-default: chord voicing; otherwise 0 for every tone

strumMs.description: Chord strum distance in milliseconds; negative strums downward.

arp.description: Chord-only arpeggiation. Requires chord and is forbidden when note is used.

voiceLead.description: Connect this chord to the chronologically previous chord event by nearest motion. Equal onsets use original note-array order as the tie-breaker.

maxLeap.description: Chord-only maximum allowed voice movement in semitones. Requires voiceLead: true.

dur.description: Duration in seconds on a plain Track.

durB.description: Duration in beats inside a Pattern or Motif.
durB.x-beatlab-effective-default: pitched: 0.5 sec after placement; drums/resamples: source duration

volTo.description: Gain target at the end of the note; 0 fades to silence.

flam.description: Adds a grace hit before a drum onset.

roll.description: Number of hits in a buzz leading into the onset.

slide.description: Glides a synth from its previous note. 1/0 are accepted for true/false.

art.description: Articulation name. Generic names (legato, tenuto, staccato, accent, ghost, mute, breathy, bend) create expression contours on synthesized, drum, and sampled notes; sampled pitched banks may also declare recorded articulations.

sampleStart.description: Seconds skipped into a sampled recording.

reverse.description: Play the selected sampled take backwards.

stretch.description: Time-fit a sampled take to explicit dur/durB without changing pitch.

region.description: Audio region selected from the current rs_ instrument.

granular.description: Per-note grain-cloud settings for an rs_ instrument. Requires explicit dur/durB and overrides the enclosing Track or Pattern granular value.

x-beatlab-required-when.note: one of note/chord, except that a lane whose instrument is one exact DrumHitName may omit both
x-beatlab-required-when.chord: one of note/chord on pitched lanes; never together with note

x-beatlab-constraints: note and chord are mutually exclusive. One is required except on a lane whose instrument is one exact DrumHitName; there, omission triggers the lane's hit at its recorded pitch, while an optional AbsolutePitch tunes that hit.
chord is legal only on a pitched lane. A drums kit lane uses note with a DrumHitName.
voicing, strumMs, arp, voiceLead, range, and maxLeap require chord and are forbidden when note is used.
A Note.maxLeap override requires voiceLead: true. Chord.maxLeap is a reusable default that becomes active when a chord event enables voiceLead.
When arp is present, strumMs is accepted but has no effect; arp supplies the generated timing.
flam and roll are mutually exclusive; use one ornament per Note.
Inside Pattern/Motif, only b and durB are legal; inside Track, only t and dur are legal.
Instrument-specific fields are rejected or ignored when the selected instrument lacks that capability.

MotifTransform.title: MotifTransform
MotifTransform.description: Transformation of a pitched note list. Operations run in a fixed order: resolve degrees and chords, retrograde, rhythm, inversion, diatonic movement, chromatic and octave movement, then voice-leading, range, and maximum-leap fitting.

invert.description: Mirror the scale-degree contour around the earliest note by local onset. Requires top-level Score.harmony.

retrograde.description: Mirror each onset inside the unscaled phrase length while preserving its pitch and duration; this changes event times, not array order.

rhythm.description: Multiplier for local onsets, durations, and the resulting phrase/cycle length or Placement repeat spacing.

chord.description: One of the keys in Score.harmony.chords Dictionary<string, Chord>. Requires voiceLead: true.

voiceLead.description: When true, requires chord and snaps notes in chronological order to nearby pitch classes from that chord.

register.description: Fallback octave for scale-degree tokens without @octave and chord events without Note.octave. If omitted, uses Harmony.octave; explicit note octaves win.

range.description: Inclusive final pitch range. Without voiceLead, notes are moved only by whole octaves to fit; compilation fails when no matching octave fits.

maxLeap.description: Hard maximum between chronologically adjacent output notes, in semitones. The compiler chooses the nearest valid octave and fails when none satisfies the limit.

x-beatlab-constraints: invert and nonzero diatonic require top-level Score.harmony; chord must resolve in Score.harmony.chords and may be supplied only with voiceLead: true.
register affects only scale-degree tokens and chord events that do not carry their own octave. range and maxLeap also work on absolute pitches without harmony.
At equal onset times, original array order is the deterministic tie-breaker for inversion and voice-leading.

Pattern.title: Pattern
Pattern.description: Reusable beat-addressed lane placed by arrangement entries.

instrument.description: Exact public sound used by this lane.

notes.description: Beat-addressed notes for this lane. Note objects use b and durB; compact NoteLine time and duration are also beats.

humanize.description: Lane timing and velocity humanization override.

groove.description: Lane groove resolved after Score.groove; omission inherits Score.groove, or applies no groove when the Score also omits it.

bus.description: Explicit mixer destination. Omission uses the instrument's automatic role: kit drums to kit, declared percussion to perc, factory bass roles to bass, transition roles to fx, and other material to bed.

pan.description: Static lane pan. A Note.pan value overrides it for that note.

lateMs.description: Timing offset applied to every note, in milliseconds.

flamMs.description: Spacing between a drum note's flam grace hit and main hit, in milliseconds; has no effect without Note.flam.

choke.description: Whether later kit-bus hat/openhat onsets cut this lane's ringing open-hi-hat tails; relevant only to open-hi-hat material on the kit bus.

granular.description: Default granular voice for notes in an rs_ resample Pattern.

lenBeats.description: Pattern cycle length in quarter-note beats.

extends.description: One of the keys in Score.patterns Dictionary<string, Pattern>. The parent is inherited before local fields and notes are applied.

motif.description: One of the keys in Score.motifs Dictionary<string, Motif>. Its pitched notes are prepended to local notes.

motifTransform.description: Transforms all pitched material produced by this Pattern, including motif notes and local notes.

omit.description: Local onset beats to remove after inheritance and motif expansion. Applied after only when both are present.

only.description: Local onset beats to retain after inheritance and motif expansion; notes at every other onset are removed.

x-beatlab-constraints: extends must resolve and must not form a cycle. It inherits the resolved parent instrument, lenBeats, notes, controls, swing, humanize, groove, bus, depth, tone, pan, lateMs, flamMs, choke, and granular. Local scalar values override, controls merge by key, and local notes are appended; child motif, motifTransform, omit, and only apply locally after inheritance.
motif and motifTransform require a pitched instrument.
Every Note object requires b >= 0 and may use durB; t and dur are not legal inside a Pattern. A compact NoteLine uses beats by context.

Transform.title: Transform
Transform.description: Repeat-local rhythmic, pitch, density, and accent development. Omitted fields make no change.

reverse.description: Reverse event groups over the existing onset positions; unlike MotifTransform.retrograde, the onset positions themselves stay fixed.

rotate.description: Circular beat displacement wrapped inside the repetition's lenBeats.

stretch.description: Multiplier for local starts and explicit durations. Repeat spacing stays fixed; starts beyond lenBeats are removed.

gate.description: Multiplier applied to explicit durations after stretch and density.

invert.description: Mirror the scale-degree contour around the earliest pitched note after timing transforms. Requires a pitched instrument and Score.harmony.

diatonic.description: Scale-step transposition. Requires a pitched instrument and Score.harmony.

chromatic.description: Semitone transposition. Requires a pitched instrument.

octave.description: Final octave displacement. Requires a pitched instrument.

density.description: Seeded onset-group density: 0 removes all, below 1 thins, 1 is unchanged, and above 1 creates bounded retriggers.

accent.description: One or more 0..2 velocity multipliers cycled over chronological onset groups; resulting note volume is clamped to 0..1.

x-beatlab-constraints: Operations run in this fixed order: reverse, rotate, stretch, pitch, density, gate, accent, then repetition-boundary clipping.
Final starts outside 0 <= beat < lenBeats are removed; explicit durations crossing lenBeats are shortened to the boundary.
When merged from a Variation, only supplied fields override the Placement's base Transform.

Condition.title: Condition
Condition.description: AND-combined selector for one-based Placement repetitions. An empty Condition selects every repetition.

first.description: true selects only repeat 1; false excludes it.

last.description: true selects only the final repeat; false excludes it.

everyNth.description: Select repeats N, 2N, 3N, and so on.

x-beatlab-constraints: All supplied selectors must match. Contradictory combinations are valid and select no repetitions.

Variation.title: Variation
Variation.description: One relative-weight candidate in a seeded mutually exclusive group. Exactly one Variation is selected for every repetition that passes Condition.

weight.description: Relative selection weight, not a percentage.

transform.description: Fields that override matching fields from Placement.transform. Omission keeps the base Transform unchanged, allowing a weighted no-additional-change candidate.

Placement.title: Placement
Placement.description: Place and optionally develop one named Pattern on the global score timeline. Processing order is motifTransform, repetition selection, Variation merge, repeat-local Transform, note probability, volume/transpose, then groove and timing.

pattern.description: One of the keys in Score.patterns Dictionary<string, Pattern>.

atBeat.description: Placement start on the global score timeline, in beats.

volFrom.description: Gain multiplier at the beginning of the complete declared placement timeline.

volTo.description: Gain multiplier at the end of the complete declared placement timeline; 0 fades to silence.

transpose.description: Placement-wide semitone transposition applied after the repeat-local Transform.

motifTransform.description: Transforms the complete pitched Pattern before repetitions are selected; rhythm also scales repeat spacing.

transform.description: Base repeat-local Transform applied independently to every repetition that passes Condition.

condition.description: Selects which one-based repetitions emit notes.

variations.description: Seeded mutually exclusive candidates. Exactly one is merged over transform for each active repetition.

groove.description: Placement-level groove override resolved after Pattern and Score groove settings.

x-beatlab-constraints: pattern must resolve. volFrom and volTo use vol as an omitted endpoint; their ramp follows the declared placement timeline and is not compressed when Condition removes repetitions.
Condition is evaluated before Variation selection. A selected Variation overrides only matching fields in transform.
motifTransform pitch fields and Transform pitch fields require a pitched Pattern.

Track.title: Track
Track.description: Plain seconds-addressed lane. Every Note object requires t in seconds; a compact NoteLine's first value is also seconds. Use Pattern + Placement for beat-addressed repetition.

id.description: Required identity for this Track. It must be unique among all objects in top-level tracks and is referenced by Sweep.track, resampling, and routing.

instrument.description: Exact public sound used by this lane.

notes.description: Seconds-addressed notes for this lane. Every Note object requires t; every compact NoteLine starts with its time in seconds.

humanize.description: Lane timing and velocity humanization override.

groove.description: Lane groove resolved after Score.groove; omission inherits Score.groove, or applies no groove when the Score also omits it.

bus.description: Explicit mixer destination. Omission uses the instrument's automatic role: kit drums to kit, declared percussion to perc, factory bass roles to bass, transition roles to fx, and other material to bed.

pan.description: Static lane pan. A Note.pan value overrides it for that note.

lateMs.description: Timing offset applied to every note, in milliseconds.

flamMs.description: Spacing between a drum note's flam grace hit and main hit, in milliseconds; has no effect without Note.flam.

choke.description: Whether later kit-bus hat/openhat onsets cut this lane's ringing open-hi-hat tails; relevant only to open-hi-hat material on the kit bus.

granular.description: Lane-level default for notes on an rs_ resample instrument. A Note.granular value overrides it.

x-beatlab-constraints: Track rejects unknown properties. Every Note object in notes requires a finite t >= 0 in seconds; b and durB are not legal inside a Track.
TrackControls rejects unknown properties and requires numeric controls to be JSON numbers within their documented ranges.

Motif.title: Motif
Motif.description: Reusable pitched phrase in beats, independent of an instrument.

notes.description: Non-empty pitched phrase. Note objects use b and durB in beats; compact NoteLine time and duration are also beats.

lenBeats.description: Phrase boundary in quarter-note beats; it determines the inherited cycle length and the boundary used by retrograde.
lenBeats.x-beatlab-effective-default: parent Motif.lenBeats when extends is set; otherwise 4

extends.description: Exact key of another Motif in Score.motifs. The resolved parent notes come first, local notes are appended, and this Motif's transform is then applied to the merged phrase.

transform.description: Applied after inheritance to the resolved parent notes followed by this Motif's local notes.

x-beatlab-constraints: Every declared Motif is validated, including motifs that no Pattern uses. Unknown properties are rejected.
Every Note object requires b >= 0 and may use durB; t and dur are not legal inside a Motif. A compact NoteLine uses beats by context.
extends must resolve and remain acyclic. Parent notes are resolved first, local notes are appended, and the child transform is applied last.

Chord.title: Chord
Chord.description: One named harmony chord definition stored under a key in Score.harmony.chords. A Note.chord event expands its tones simultaneously unless strumMs or arp changes their timing.

tones.description: Scale degrees or absolute pitches expanded by a Note.chord event.

voicing.description: Named Harmony.voicings key or one octave offset per tone.

range.description: Default inclusive pitch range for this chord. Tones move only by whole octaves to fit.

maxLeap.description: Default maximum movement per corresponding chord voice, used only when a Note.chord event sets voiceLead: true.

Harmony.title: Harmony
Harmony.description: Tonality, reusable voicings, and named chords resolved before rendering.

tonic.description: Pitch class such as C, Bb, or F#.

pitchSet.description: Custom ascending unique semitone offsets; must include 0.

voicings.description: Reusable named chord voicings. Each value contains one -4..4 octave offset per chord tone.

additionalProperties.description: One octave offset per chord tone.

chords.description: Named chord definitions. Each dictionary key is a valid value for Note.chord.

x-beatlab-constraints: An omitted Harmony property uses C as tonic, major as scale, octave 4, and empty voicings/chords dictionaries. The top-level Harmony object itself is required whenever a scale-degree token is used.
pitchSet and scale are alternative scale definitions; pitchSet must be sorted, unique, and contain 0.
When a Chord references a named voicing, that voicing's length must match the Chord.tones count.
Every declared voicing and Chord is validated even when no Note references it. Unknown properties are rejected.

Groove.title: Groove
Groove.description: One meter-length timing and velocity pocket map.

timingMs.description: Signed timing offset per cycle step.

accent.description: Emphasis mapped to a 0.5..1.5 velocity multiplier.

phaseBeat.description: Global score beat at which step zero begins.

x-beatlab-constraints: Every supplied array has meterNumerator * 4 / meterDenominator * stepsPerBeat entries.
The computed cycle length must be 1..256 whole steps.
Notes read the nearest subdivision step without quantizing their authored onset. The selected timing offset is clamped to 45% of the real local subdivision so adjacent grid events cannot cross.
The target force at one step is velocity[step] * (1 + accent[step] * 0.5).
Every declared Groove is validated even when no lane uses it. Unknown properties and non-numeric JSON values are rejected.

GrooveUse.title: GrooveUse
GrooveUse.description: A named groove with independent timing/velocity strength and optional phase override.

phaseBeat.description: Override the map's global phase anchor.

x-beatlab-constraints: map must resolve when supplied; without map, this object needs an inherited groove map.
amount blends both timing and force, timing multiplies only the timing blend, and velocity multiplies only the velocity/accent blend.

A GrooveUse overrides only the fields it supplies, including when it supplies a new map. A string GrooveBinding selects a map and resets amount/timing/velocity to 1 and phaseBeat to that Groove's phaseBeat.

GrooveBinding.title: GrooveBinding
GrooveBinding.description: A groove name, true to inherit, false to opt out, or a configured GrooveUse.
GrooveBinding.x-beatlab-syntax: one of the keys in Score.grooves Dictionary<string, Groove> | boolean | GrooveUse
x-beatlab-constraints: String/map names must resolve to a top-level grooves key.
Bindings resolve from Score.groove to Track/Pattern.groove to Placement.groove. true preserves the inherited choice, false clears it, and a GrooveUse overrides only the fields it supplies.
Score.groove is validated even when the score currently contains no lane that inherits it.

TempoPoint.title: TempoPoint
TempoPoint.description: Beat-addressed step or linear BPM segment start.

atBeat.description: Tempo-segment start on the global score timeline, in beats.

bpm.description: Tempo from this point, in quarter-note beats per minute.

curve.description: Interpolation from this point to the next.

x-beatlab-constraints: curve belongs to this TempoPoint and controls the segment from this point to the next. The final point's curve has no effect.
linear changes BPM linearly over beat position; step holds this point's BPM until the next point.

Keyframe.title: Keyframe
Keyframe.description: Automation point [beat, value, curve?]. Curve shapes the segment into this point.
x-beatlab-constraints: The optional curve belongs to the destination keyframe: it shapes movement from the previous keyframe into this one. Omitting it means linear. A curve on the first keyframe has no effect.
Within a segment, let f run from 0 at the previous keyframe to 1 at the destination. linear uses f; exp uses f^3; log uses 1-(1-f)^3; scurve uses f^2*(3-2*f).
step holds the previous keyframe's value for the whole segment, then jumps to the destination value exactly at the destination beat.

KnobKeyframe.title: KnobKeyframe
KnobKeyframe.description: Compact automation point with a public 0..10 knob value.
x-beatlab-constraints: The optional curve belongs to the destination keyframe: it shapes movement from the previous keyframe into this one. Omitting it means linear. A curve on the first keyframe has no effect.
Within a segment, let f run from 0 at the previous keyframe to 1 at the destination. linear uses f; exp uses f^3; log uses 1-(1-f)^3; scurve uses f^2*(3-2*f).
step holds the previous keyframe's value for the whole segment, then jumps to the destination value exactly at the destination beat.

Lfo.title: Lfo
Lfo.description: Tempo-synchronized sine automation over a finite beat window.

atBeat.description: LFO start on the global score timeline, in beats.

depth.description: Full swing width in target units.

center.description: Resting value; required for exact param automation.

CenteredLfo.title: CenteredLfo
CenteredLfo.description: Tempo-synchronized sine automation for a native-unit param target.

atBeat.description: LFO start on the global score timeline, in beats.

depth.description: Full swing width in target units.

CompactLfo.title: CompactLfo
CompactLfo.description: Tempo-synchronized sine automation in the compact 0..10 knob scale.

atBeat.description: LFO start on the global score timeline, in beats.

depth.description: Full swing width in knob units.

TrackParam.title: TrackParam
TrackParam.description: Exact continuous target in native units. This is how fader and pan are automated.
x-beatlab-constraints: synth.* targets require a synthesized instrument.
blend/sync/ring/shape/pitch1/pitch2 require an ex_ dual-oscillator patch.

Sweep.title: Sweep
Sweep.description: One compact knob or exact parameter on selected tracks, moved by keyframes or a finite LFO.

track.description: The id property of one direct Track in top-level tracks. The sweep applies only to that authored Track across its complete score timeline.

pattern.description: One exact key from the top-level patterns object. The sweep applies to every arrangement placement of that Pattern, but not to Patterns that extend it.

instrument.description: The instrument property of a Track or Pattern. The sweep applies globally to every direct Track and arranged Pattern using it, regardless of bus.

knob.description: Compact 0..10 target. fader/pan are intentionally absent.

res.description: Optional resonance state change for a compact lowpass/highpass sweep. It begins at points[0][0] or lfo.atBeat and holds for this track + filter until a later sweep supplies res.

x-beatlab-constraints: Exactly one of track/pattern/instrument is required.
track resolves against the id property of one direct Track in top-level tracks.
pattern resolves only against one exact top-level patterns key. All arrangement placements receive the sweep; Patterns that extend it do not.
instrument resolves against the instrument property of direct Tracks and arranged Patterns. Every match receives the sweep, regardless of bus.
Target names are case-sensitive. A target that resolves to nothing is an error.
Exactly one of knob/param and exactly one of points/lfo are required.
points contains 2..64 strictly ascending beat-addressed keyframes.
A knob LFO is legal only for lowpass/highpass/pump and uses compact 0..10 units. A param LFO requires center and uses that param's native units.
res is legal only with compact knob lowpass/highpass; it is an error on every other knob or exact param.
Lowpass and highpass resonance are independent per track. Each starts at controls.res when present, otherwise 0. Omitting res retains that filter's current value.

A res value takes effect at the sweep's first point and holds until a later sweep for the same track + filter supplies another value. Conflicting values at the same beat are errors; automation array order has no effect.
Compact synth knobs, including cutoff/resonance/drive, are sampled at note onsets; their synth.* exact-param counterparts move continuously inside held notes.

BusSweep.title: BusSweep
BusSweep.description: Native-unit automation of one declared custom bus, effect, or send property.

bus.description: Case-sensitive exact key from Score.buses. This always selects the containing custom Bus.

effect.description: Case-sensitive id of one effect in the selected Bus. When present, param selects a property of this effect.

send.description: Case-sensitive id of one send in the selected Bus. When present, param must be amount.

points.description: Strictly ascending beat-addressed keyframes whose values use the selected property's native units.

lfo.description: Finite native-unit LFO. It starts and finishes at center, and its full excursion must fit the selected property's range.

x-beatlab-constraints: The three target forms are: bus alone changes the Bus itself; bus + effect changes that effect; bus + send changes that send. effect and send must never appear together.
bus must resolve to a declared custom Bus. effect and send ids resolve only inside that Bus. All references are case-sensitive; an unresolved reference is an error.
Bus properties: fader 0..1; pan -1..1; sidechain.amount 0..10, only when that Bus declares sidechain.
Send property: amount 0..1 is the only automatable send property.

Effect properties: eq low/mid/high -12..12 dB and mix 0..1; drive/crush/tape amount 0..10 and mix 0..1; chorus/phaser rateHz 0.01..10, depth 0..1, feedback -0.9..0.9, and mix 0..1; delay timeBeats 0.0625..4, feedback 0..0.92, and mix 0..1; reverb size/damping/mix 0..1 and tone -1..1; filter cutoff 30..16000 Hz, resonance 0..0.9, and mix 0..1; width amount 0..2; tremolo rateHz 0.01..20 and depth/mix 0..1.
Only an existing numeric property may move. Routing, ids, effect types, and filter mode remain static.
Before the earliest keyframe, the selected property's configured value remains active. After the latest keyframe, its value holds.
Several BusSweep entries for the same property merge into one time-sorted envelope. Values interpolate across a gap; to hold across it, begin the later entry at the held value.
Conflicting points at the same beat are errors; automation array order has no effect.
Point values and the complete LFO excursion must stay inside the selected property's native range; out-of-range values are errors.
A CenteredLfo begins at center, returns to center at its ending beat, and then holds center until later automation changes the property.

Automation.title: Automation
Automation.description: A Sweep or BusSweep. track.fader/track.pan replace the removed compact fader/pan knobs.

atBeat.description: Move start on the global score timeline, in beats.

unitBeats.description: Stutter slice length in beats. On another move it is still validated as positive, then has no audio effect.

BusEffect.title: BusEffect
BusEffect.description: Strict discriminated bus insert. The type selects the legal parameter set.

id.description: Unique effect id inside this bus.
Unique effect id inside this bus.
Unique effect id inside this bus.
Unique effect id inside this bus.
Unique effect id inside this bus.
Unique effect id inside this bus.
Unique effect id inside this bus.
Unique effect id inside this bus.

Unique effect id inside this bus.
Unique effect id inside this bus.

x-beatlab-constraints: id and type are required. The selected type permits only its documented properties.
Every supplied numeric value must be a JSON number inside its documented range; values are never coerced or clamped.
Effect ids are unique within one bus; maximum eight effects per bus.

Send.title: Send
Send.description: Copy part of one custom Bus into hall, plate, or another custom Bus as a parallel signal path.

id.description: Unique send id inside this bus.

to.description: Built-in return or declared custom bus.

x-beatlab-constraints: Every supplied numeric value must be a JSON number inside its documented range; values are never coerced or clamped.

Sidechain.title: Sidechain
Sidechain.description: Duck one custom Bus after its insert effects and before its fader/pan, driven by one or more exact sources.

from.description: Exact detector sources. Their strongest level wins at each sample; array order has no effect.

x-beatlab-constraints: Every supplied numeric value must be a JSON number inside its documented range; values are never coerced or clamped.
Every source symbol must resolve; duplicate sources are errors and custom-bus routing/sidechains must remain acyclic.
A drumHit or trigger source uses a fixed 20 ms control pulse at each event; attackMs and releaseMs determine the audible duck shape.

Bus.title: Bus
Bus.description: Declared custom mixing bus. Its Score.buses object key is its routing identity. The completed Bus is mixed into the built-in role selected by role.

role.description: Built-in role bus that receives this custom Bus's completed output.

effects.description: Insert chain processed in array order; changing the order can change the sound.

sends.description: Parallel feeds processed in array order after this Bus's fader and pan; each Send.tap chooses pre or post audio.

x-beatlab-constraints: Every supplied numeric value must be a JSON number inside its documented range; values are never coerced or clamped.
Effect ids are unique among this Bus's effects, and send ids are unique among this Bus's sends. The two id namespaces are separate.
The complete custom-bus send and sidechain graph must be acyclic.
A custom Bus can be a duckable effect return: send audio to it, use a reverb or delay with mix 1, and put sidechain on that return Bus. Built-in hall and plate returns are not sidechain targets.

ResampleSource.title: ResampleSource
ResampleSource.description: Exactly one authored track or capturable bus.

oneOf.title: Track capture source
oneOf.description: Capture one rendered lane by an exact direct Track id or top-level Pattern key.

track.description: Exact id property of one top-level Track, or exact key from Score.patterns.

oneOf.title: Bus capture source
oneOf.description: Capture a built-in musical or declared custom bus.

x-beatlab-constraints: The symbol must resolve; hall, plate, and master are not capturable buses.

RegionRange.title: RegionRange
RegionRange.description: [startBeat, endBeat], both relative to the beginning of the capture.
x-beatlab-constraints: end must be greater than start and no later than the capture length.

ResampleSlices.title: ResampleSlices
ResampleSlices.description: Optional single method for exposing named or numbered regions.

gridBeats.description: Length of every generated slice in capture-relative beats.

Resample.title: Resample
Resample.description: Bounded pre-render capture exposed as a temporary rs_ instrument.

fromBeat.description: Capture start on the global score timeline, in beats.

x-beatlab-constraints: Maximum 16 captures, 32 seconds per capture, and 120 seconds across all captures after tempo conversion.
Maximum 128 generated regions and 120 seconds of overlapping explicit-region material per capture.
Captures may not depend on rs_ instruments.

GranularCurvePoint.title: GranularCurvePoint
GranularCurvePoint.description: Two-number point [phase, value]. Phase is 0..1 from the beginning to the end of the note; value is 1..200 grains/second for density and source position 0..1 for scan.
x-beatlab-constraints: A GranularCurvePoint always contains exactly two numbers.

GranularCurve.title: GranularCurve
GranularCurve.description: A constant number or a normalized phase curve.

oneOf.description: 2..32 strictly ordered points from phase 0 to 1.

The property using the curve sets the value range: Granular.density uses 1..200; Granular.scan uses 0..1.

GranularWindow.title: GranularWindow
GranularWindow.description: String enum selecting the amplitude shape applied to every grain.

Granular.title: Granular
Granular.description: Deterministic grain-cloud playback for an rs_ instrument.

grainMs.description: Maximum source fragment length in milliseconds.

density.description: Grains per second as a constant or phase curve.

scan.description: Source position as a constant or 0..1 phase curve.

positionJitter.description: Random source-position displacement as a region fraction.

window.description: Amplitude shape applied to each grain.

CompactSynthPatch.title: CompactSynthPatch
CompactSynthPatch.description: Single-oscillator subtractive/FM patch. osc identifies this architecture; there is no version field.

pitchDropSec.description: Attack pitch convergence time in seconds.

Oscillator.description: Strict wave-discriminated oscillator for a dual-oscillator patch.

table.description: One waveform cycle; compiler removes DC and peak-normalizes it.

SynthEnvelope.title: SynthEnvelope
SynthEnvelope.description: ADSR envelope in seconds plus normalized sustain. It has no universal defaults: DualSynthPatch.amp and DualSynthPatch.env2 each document the defaults inherited by omitted fields.

SynthLfo.title: SynthLfo
SynthLfo.description: Free-running patch LFO. It has no universal defaults: DualSynthPatch.lfo1 and DualSynthPatch.lfo2 each document the defaults inherited by omitted fields.

ModRoute.title: ModRoute
x-beatlab-constraints: amount must remain inside the selected target's documented range; out-of-range values are compile errors and are never clamped.

model.description: Model discriminator. Must be "kick" for KickDrumPatch.

bus.description: Default mixer role for the generated drum. Track.bus or Pattern.bus overrides it.

pitchVarCents.description: Seeded per-hit body-pitch displacement selected uniformly from -pitchVarCents through +pitchVarCents.

pitchStartHz.description: Initial body frequency; it may be above or below tuneHz.

pitchDecay.description: Exponential pitch-sweep time constant in seconds. After this time, 36.8% of the initial distance from tuneHz remains.

ClapDrumPatch.title: ClapDrumPatch

model.description: Model discriminator. Must be "clap" for ClapDrumPatch.

bus.description: Default mixer role for the generated drum. Track.bus or Pattern.bus overrides it.

duration.description: Default hard generated-audio length in seconds when Note.dur or Note.durB is omitted. A note duration replaces it up to the custom hit's 4-second limit; synthesis extending beyond the selected length is truncated.

gain.description: Patch output gain. It must be greater than 0 so the patch is audible.

decayVar.description: Seeded per-hit multiplier applied to body and noise decays, uniformly selected from 1-decayVar through 1+decayVar.

toneVar.description: Chooses one seeded per-hit tone factor uniformly from 1-toneVar through 1+toneVar. The factor multiplies filter and click frequencies, shifts dark/bright noise filtering, and moves each metal partial away from or toward ratio 1 using 1 + (ratio - 1) * factor.

pitchVarCents.description: Seeded per-hit pitch displacement of the optional tonal body, selected uniformly from -pitchVarCents through +pitchVarCents.

spread.description: Seeded looseness after the first burst: timing may move by up to 45% of spacingMs * spread and level by up to 30% * spread. This does not create stereo width.

x-beatlab-constraints: All supplied numbers must remain inside their documented ranges; out-of-range values are compile errors and are never clamped.
highpassHz must be lower than lowpassHz.
duration is the default hard generated-audio length. Note.dur or Note.durB replaces it up to the custom hit's 4-second limit; synthesis beyond the selected length is truncated.
bus is the default route. An explicit Track.bus or Pattern.bus overrides it.
The patch must contain an audible source and gain must be greater than 0.

density.description: Expected number of seeded short-noise grain triggers per second.

x-beatlab-constraints: All supplied numbers must remain inside their documented ranges; out-of-range values are compile errors and are never clamped.

pitchVarCents is not a NoiseDrumPatch field because this model has no pitched component.

MetalDrumPatch.title: MetalDrumPatch

model.description: Model discriminator. Must be "metal" for MetalDrumPatch.

bus.description: Default mixer role for the generated drum. Track.bus or Pattern.bus overrides it.

duration.description: Default hard generated-audio length in seconds when Note.dur or Note.durB is omitted. A note duration replaces it up to the custom hit's 4-second limit; synthesis extending beyond the selected length is truncated.

gain.description: Patch output gain. It must be greater than 0 so the patch is audible.

decayVar.description: Seeded per-hit multiplier applied to body and noise decays, uniformly selected from 1-decayVar through 1+decayVar.

toneVar.description: Chooses one seeded per-hit tone factor uniformly from 1-toneVar through 1+toneVar. The factor multiplies filter and click frequencies, shifts dark/bright noise filtering, and moves each metal partial away from or toward ratio 1 using 1 + (ratio - 1) * factor.

pitchVarCents.description: Seeded per-hit displacement of the metallic partial bank, selected uniformly from -pitchVarCents through +pitchVarCents.

tuneHz.description: Reference frequency multiplied by every value in partials.

partials.description: Strictly ascending frequency multipliers of tuneHz. Earlier, lower partials are rendered louder and longer.

damping.description: Increasingly suppresses and shortens later partials in array order; 0 preserves them most and 1 damps them most.

x-beatlab-constraints: All supplied numbers must remain inside their documented ranges; out-of-range values are compile errors and are never clamped.
highpassHz must be lower than lowpassHz.
duration is the default hard generated-audio length. Note.dur or Note.durB replaces it up to the custom hit's 4-second limit; synthesis beyond the selected length is truncated.
bus is the default route. An explicit Track.bus or Pattern.bus overrides it.
The patch must contain an audible source and gain must be greater than 0.
partials must contain 2..8 strictly ascending ratios; array order defines the renderer's partial damping order.

CustomDrumPatch.title: CustomDrumPatch
CustomDrumPatch.description: A model-discriminated exd_ electronic drum patch. Model-inapplicable fields are errors.
x-beatlab-constraints: model is the required discriminator; every other field is optional and receives the selected model's documented default.
The patch must remain audible: gain must be greater than 0 and at least one source level used by that model must be greater than 0.

x-beatlab-rejected-forms: Compact automation knobs fader and pan: use track.fader and track.pan exact params.
Top-level era, Track era, and mix.glue: not language fields; use top-level glue.
Synth patch version: not a language field; osc or osc1+osc2 identifies the architecture.
Compiler-output fields fxAuto, automation on Track/Bus, and underscore-prefixed internal fields.
